title: gpui-kit
brief: Rust GUI components for building cross-platform desktop apps on GPUI (the framework behind Zed). ~14.8k stars — one of the more-starred GPUI component libraries.
details: GPUI Kit is a comprehensive Rust desktop application framework built on GPUI (the UI framework from Zed Industries) — 75+ documented components and primitives with polished interactions, GPU-accelerated 120 FPS rendering, virtualized data tables and lists, a code editor stable at 200K lines with Tree-sitter and LSP, dock layouts, native Markdown/HTML rendering, AccessKit accessibility, UI integration testing, and WebAssembly support. Three layers: gpui-component (the complete styled system, best for applications), gpui-base (unstyled behavior and infrastructure, best for building your own design system), and gpui-shell (a JavaScript extension runtime). One dependency (`gpui-kit = "0.7"`) pins the matching GPUI release. It was extracted from Longbridge Pro, a publicly shipped commercial desktop app — production-proven rather than designed in isolation — and carries 15.8k stars. Apache-2.0 (docs prose CC BY 4.0); agent skills installable via `npx skills add longbridge/gpui-kit`.
